title.narrative: Improved coherence in multilateral support for the development and financing of integrated policy responses for social justice through decent work

description.narrative:
The ILO will strategically leverage its position and its participation in high-level political forums to support its constituents in navigating global challenges and to scale up and amplify its work, ensuring that the Organization's human-centred approach is reflected in global policy agendas and is effectively implemented. The Global Coalition for Social Justice will be the main vehicle for the mobilization of political commitments, cooperation and investments for social justice at all levels. In this framework, the Global Accelerator on Jobs and Social Protection for Just Transitions will play a key role in driving collaboration and support for the development and financing of integrated policy responses to create decent jobs and extend social protection.
The Global Coalition is a voluntary, multi-stakeholder initiative convened by the ILO to foster action, collaboration and coherence for social justice and decent work. It brings together governments, employers’ and workers’ organizations, international and regional organizations and financial institutions, businesses, international non-governmental organizations and academia, committed to advancing social justice. Its work is organized around three means of intervention: promoting concrete actions and policy coherence; agenda-setting, advocacy and communications; and knowledge generation and dissemination, through key interventions in areas such as living wages, sustainable enterprises and responsible business conduct, youth employment, transition to formality, just transition, social protection, employment , and sustainable investments, underpinned by international labour standards and social dialogue
